history.summary: BOM import data handling (D-0172): dates imported and the revision in effect pinned; document lines by name, suffix and ZST; struck text never current; standard values; make/buy only from a source value; revision marks listed for review; ECO numbers per part; prototypes as CL1 #; -0 not a revision; Z revisions checked

Speed and stability: plain-note changes no longer rebuild the model index; flow and run records are parsed once and their databases rebuilt only when a record changes; prepared statements reused; Testbench no longer redraws (and drops typing) on every inbox poll, reads the inbox asynchronously, and the phone server drops stalled uploads.

Type check in CI (GOV-002) with the errors it found fixed, including two display bugs (Keywords examples column, ECO add button) and a duplicate importer message; one-command version bump; Raised by and Tested by filled from the person note; handover refreshed.
Flow guide wording: placeholders read as plain text, conditional required fields are marked (for example Material, mechanical only) (Workbench 0.12.2, Testbench 0.1.2).
Flow guides: one Markdown guide per flow in 99_System/07_Guides/Flows, generated from the flow definitions and opened from the ? button on an open flow (Workbench 0.12.1, Testbench 0.1.1, D-0171).

Workbench 0.12.0 keeps flow tracking and drafts in a local SQLite database (.mdse/workbench.db, sql.js); the base vault ignores .mdse/. New separate Testbench 0.1.0 plugin for test plans, runs and evidence capture (not bundled in the base vault yet) (D-0170).

Workbench 0.11.0 adds the Flow drop-down beside the work areas: eleven PLM flows (Change, New part, Redline, Issue, Review and approve, Options and alternates, Specify, Firmware, Document, Test plan, Test report) with Submitted sections, saved as records in _ops/Flows (D-0169, WKB-076, WKB-077).
Base vault adds Inkling 1.0.1 for drawing redlines (D-0167); Workbench 0.10.4 orders top canvas cards with the vendored d3-dag 2.0.0 when that gives fewer crossing lines (D-0168).
Paired toolset/Workbench update: canvas rows keep shared parts between their parents and unique parts toward their own parent (D-0166).
Context-only workflow projections; unrelated elements are introduced explicitly through vault Search and Canvas addition.
Paired toolset/Workbench source update for global search-to-active-Canvas addition.
Independent Importer version, visible toolset version, content fingerprint and CI version-bump enforcement.
Importer inherited the 0.10.0 toolset release and displayed a build hash; there was no separately maintained Importer version.
